business_summary.text: SKF India (Industrial) Limited makes bearings and related products for industrial customers, including general machinery, wind, rail, heavy industry and agriculture, and was demerged from SKF India Limited.

call_points.text: Aspiration to double the business has no firm timeline; management said five years on the outside.
New Pune plant capex of ₹900-950 Cr is progressing as planned, with production expected from 2028.
New Pune tapered roller bearing line adds 3 million units a year for India and exports.
One more tapered roller bearing channel to be added by early 2027; most new lines wait for the new factory.
General machinery, wind, heavy and rail did well; management is trying to bring down India automotive sales to improve mix.
Cash conversion was 63.0% in the quarter; operating cash flow fell on one-time name-change and land-transfer charges.
Pune plant investment has a stated payback of five to seven years.
Demerger IT costs are expected to continue for the next two quarters until AB SKF separates globally.
Management sees margin pressure for the next couple of years as localisation increases, with improvement only beyond 2028.
Solutions business is 6-7% of India business; humanoid robots and data centres are early and not significant yet.
No active plan to merge group entities; management wants the demerger to stabilise first.
Total capex of over ₹800 crores is planned between FY26 and FY30, including the new Pune plant.
Wind sector OEM sales surged 91.0% QoQ driven by orders from ZF and Suzlon.

guidance.statement: Aiming to reach 15% EBITDA margin by FY29-FY30
PBT margin guided at 14-16%, with margin pressure for the next couple of years and improvement beyond 2028
Aspiration to double the business, with five years on the outside as the timeline
New Pune plant capex of ₹900-950 Cr, with production expected from 2028

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Abrasives & Bearings

operating_notes.text: Sustained momentum reported across wind, railways and metals sectors.
Planned over ₹800 crore capex through FY30, including a new Pune plant to be commissioned by end of calendar year 2028.
Distribution is 34% of Q1FY27 revenue and OE 54%, with distribution earning high double-digit margins and OE high single-digit.
The solutions business, including services, remanufacturing and condition monitoring, is 6-7% of the India business.
The new Pune tapered roller bearing line adds 3 million units a year, serving agriculture, gearbox and aftermarket.
Postal ballot approved Sujeeth Pai as Managing Director for 5 years effective September 1, 2026, and Mukund Vasudevan as Non-Executive Director.

holders.name: Hdfc Mutual Fund - Hdfc Mid-Cap Fund

timeline.summary: Aktiebolaget SKF (AB SKF) (publ.) declared its 2,59,92,059 shares in SKF India (Industrial) Limited are unencumbered on 31.03.2026, holding 52.58% of equity.
SKF India (Industrial) Limited’s **Poorva Bang** schedules earnings call on **May 13, 2026, at 3:00 PM (IST)** to discuss FY26 Q4 & annual results.
On 12 May 2026, SKF India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹945.72 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹10 per share.
On 13 May 2026, SKF India reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹945.72 Cr and PBT of ₹899.7 million.
On 13 May 2026, SKF India (Industrial) hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting ₹950 Cr sales and outlining ₹800 Cr capex plans through FY30.

On 14 August 2026 SKF India (Industrial) held its first earnings call after the demerger, reporting Q1FY27 revenue of ₹971 Cr (up 18.3% YoY) and PBT of ₹87 Cr at a 9.0% margin, and guiding to a 14-16% PBT margin with the new Pune plant producing from 2028.
SKF India (Industrial) shareholders approved the appointment of Sujeeth Pai as Managing Director and Mukund Vasudevan as Non-Executive Director via postal ballot.
Mr. Sujeeth Pai (DIN: 07763929) appointed Managing Director of SKF India (Industrial) Limited, effective 1 September 2026, for a term of five consecutive years.
Mr. Mukund Vasudevan (DIN: 05146681) appointed as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director on the Board of SKF India (Industrial) Limited effective 1 September 2026.
